title: outlet~

messages.description: signal to send to parent patch

arguments.description: downsampling method. 'hold' for sample/hold, 'pad' for zero-padded and 'lin' for linear interpolation

body: [outlet~] creates a signal outlet on the box of the subpatch or abstraction it is in, and sends the signal it receives out of it. In a subpatch with a different sample rate, the argument sets the resampling method.
